name: TV Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: a purple flat-screen TV showing a shadowy figure in a hat and dark glasses, with a purple plasma wisp
entry: It shows only a shadowy figure and the words "this program is unavailable". Viewers cannot look away.
how: Use a Remote Control on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Night Daze in this form.
